searchText: What was the verdict? Meet or postpone? not much of a response here. No one joined either, so I suppose, let's meet on Jan 12th. OK. I will update the agenda. I just launched the eip labelling feature. Basically, it will label a PR with as many labels that are relevant. Each file can only have one label type per, so if you have multiple files your PR can have multiple labels. But the associated label is mentioned in the bot's comment. Keep a look out for any times where something is assigned one thing when it shouldn't etc. There are lot of edges here, but the code is robust.
